supplement.stop_rule: after each paired four-candidate round, stop a question once both arms have four unique correct uncapped texts
supplement.exhaustion_rule: record failure and do not train; never drop questions or replace unique texts with repetitions

claim_boundary: Exploratory GSM8K on the fixed previously observed 878-question cohort and one SAE seed. Distinct answers mean distinct stripped texts, not distinct mathematical solution methods. Repeat controls match examples, question exposure and optimizer steps, not supervision tokens. Refit k=1 from the same supplemented pool; historical adapters are not the current baseline. No OOD or equal-token claims.
